research.thaumic_create.root.title: Mechanical Magic
research.thaumic_create.root.subtitle: Create meets thaumaturgy
research.thaumic_create.root.body:
History shows that thaumaturgy has existed for a very long time, unlike the mechanisms now filling the world. During your latest project... Or was it your latest research? Never mind! At some point, a thought struck you: why not combine magic with machinery?

After all, these mechanisms open up entirely new possibilities for storing, transporting and using essentia! What is stopping you from creating an essentia generator? Or a pump that draws essentia through mirrors? Yes, this is exactly what you have been missing!

Why did you not think of this sooner...
research.thaumic_create.create_diorite.b: Add one Praecantatio and one Ordo to a boiling crucible, then drop in one block of ordinary stone to produce diorite.
Add one Praecantatio and one Aer to a boiling crucible, then drop in one block of ordinary stone to produce andesite for Create machinery.
research.thaumic_create.create_granite.s: We did not forget this one either
research.thaumic_create.create_granite.b: Granite retains the fire of the depths. Add one Praecantatio and one Ignis to a boiling crucible, then drop in one block of ordinary stone.
research.thaumic_create.brass.title: Alchemical Brass
research.thaumic_create.brass.subtitle: Alchemization
research.thaumic_create.brass.body:
Scanning a brass ingot with the thaumometer makes this research available. Obtain research notes and solve the puzzle with Metallum, Permutatio and Praecantatio anchors.

After completing the research, add one Permutatio, one Praecantatio and one Metallum to a boiling crucible, then drop in a lead ingot to obtain one Create brass ingot.
research.thaumic_create.plate_thaumium.b:
The Create mechanical press turns one ingot into one plate.

Research cost: 4 Metallum + 2 Praecantatio. Study the corresponding metal first.

When a player places an ingot on a depot under a press, their plate research is checked. Existing presses do not need to be replaced.
research.thaumic_create.plate_void.title: Void Metal Plate
research.thaumic_create.plate_void.subti: When science reaches a dead end
research.thaumic_create.plate_void.body:

research.thaumic_create.essentia_adapter:
Through experiments with Thaumium Plates and a Fluid Tank, you have found a way to tame the destructive nature of essentia.

By reinforcing the tank with Thaumium and treating it with Quicksilver and Salis Mundus, you have created a converter capable of holding essentia and directing it into ordinary fluid pipes. Andesite Alloy components allow a Mechanical Pump to be attached securely.

The converter holds up to 64 units of a single aspect. A Mechanical Pump must be attached to its fluid port; pipes can then be connected to the pump.

For the converter to draw essentia from thaumaturgical tubes and send it onward, the pump must rotate at no less than 16 RPM. Reversing the pump allows essentia to flow back into the converter. If the pump is stopped or rotating too slowly, the converter accepts no essentia and supplies none to the fluid pipes. However, essentia already inside can still be drawn out through thaumaturgical tubes.

All that remains is to find a strong and spacious enough vessel to hold the essentia you have collected.
research.thaumic_create.essentia_tank.bo:
A Create-style multiblock storing one essentia aspect. Ordinary fluids and mixed aspects are rejected.

64 units per block; four blocks hold 256. Footprints: 1×1 or 2×2, up to 10 blocks tall. Maximum: 2×2×10, holding 2560 units.

Use Create pumps and pipes, and an adapter for TR tubes. Requires Essentia Adapter research. Drain before dismantling; splitting follows Create tank rules.
research.thaumic_create.engine.title: Essentia Engine
research.thaumic_create.engine.subtitle: Kinetic essentia
research.thaumic_create.engine.body:
Supply Potentia to the base and connect shafts to the sides of the upper part.

Hold right-click on the front panel to select 1–128 RPM. Fuel is paid every 40 ticks, preserving fractional units. Speed changes apply at the next paid interval. Starts at 8 RPM for 0.5 Potentia per 40 ticks. Aspect selection is not enabled.
research.thaumic_create.engine_arbor.bod:
Infusion unlocks arbor fuel. Both ordinary and upgraded engines are accepted. Other upgrades are preserved.

Right-click the lower aspect panel to cycle fuels; each fuel reserve is preserved separately. Hold Shift over the item to view supported fuels.
research.thaumic_create.engine_praecanta:
Infusion unlocks praecantatio fuel. Both ordinary and upgraded engines are accepted. Other upgrades are preserved.

Right-click the lower aspect panel to cycle fuels; each fuel reserve is preserved separately. Hold Shift over the item to view supported fuels.
research.thaumic_create.essentia_pump.bo:
Since inventing essentia mirrors, you have sought a way to use them with devices that can only receive essentia through tubes. Every attempt proved fruitless until a Mechanical Pump came into your hands. By adding a mirror and bellows and fitting it with essentia valves, you finally found a solution.

The pump reads the connected device’s request and draws the required essentia through a linked essentia mirror within 8 blocks. A mirror in front of the pump is used first. Place the pump on an input face of the device.

Receivers without a selected aspect can draw available aspects on their own. Right-click the valve to close the pump.
